CompanionMode.Name: Companion token visibility
CompanionMode.Hint: How the hidden second actor's token is kept out of sight. Transparent tokens are visible to every user (so vision and animations work) but drawn fully see-through. Hidden tokens use Foundry's GM-hidden flag.

ShowBadge.Name: Show rider target badge
ShowBadge.Hint: Show a label on the main token when its linked actor is targeted, because the linked token itself is invisible.

HUD.Link: Link a second actor to this token

Link.Title: Link Second Actor
Link.Label: Rider
Link.Hint: This actor gets an invisible token that follows this one. Targeting this token will ask which actor you mean.

Image.Hint: Linking switches the token to the rider image, and unlinking switches it back. Leave the rider image empty to keep the token image unchanged. These images are saved on this token's actor and used in every scene.

Link.NoActors: There are no player characters you can link.

Unlink.Title: Unlink Second Actor
Unlink.Content: Remove {companion} from {primary}? Their invisible token will be deleted from this scene.

Target.Title: Choose Target
Target.Content: Which actor on {name} are you targeting?

Errors.GMOnly: Only a GM can link or unlink actors.
Errors.NoGM: A GM must be connected to link or unlink actors.
Errors.Timeout: The GM's client did not respond. Make sure the GM's Foundry tab is open and has been reloaded since the module was updated, then try again.
Errors.NoSocket: Fey Mounted: players can't link their own mounts until Foundry is fully restarted. The running server loaded an older version of this module.
Errors.SlowGM: The GM's client is taking a long time to finish. Check the token before trying again.
Errors.Permission: You must own both the token and the rider to link or unlink them.
